payload.text: Journal CRC-32 table safety (deliverable: journal-durability). build_table is a const fn computing the reflected IEEE CRC-32 (polynomial 0xEDB88320) lookup table purely from compile-time constants — referentially transparent by construction, no I/O, no mutable global state escaping the function, identical on every build and every platform. This is the deterministic root the entire journal torn-tail / corruption-rejection guarantee rests on: a stable table means a stable CRC. Pure (no WRITES edges); self-invalidates if the table derivation changes.
